memo: Validation run, NO submission. e3val2/e3val3 showed the base ranks an in-pool truth near the top (np-examples MRR ~0.92, hit@25 0.99), so the LB 0.45 gap is likely truths missing from the candidate pool. This run measures that case: np-examples 250 molecules, c1 = only np-examples rows leave train; c2 (= class 3 here) = all spectra leave train AND the structure leaves the engine-1 pool (filtered copy of POOL_DIR, also read by the PubChem worker) and the engine-2 pool (COCONUT + ChEBI/LIPID MAPS + train), so only the PubChem tier can still propose it. Engine-1 FP bank = FPNet A. build.py val4 base=a451 val=250 valsrc=np valc3=1. Purpose: how often and how high the PubChem path puts an out-of-pool truth, to aim the next component.
